title: Document reusable advisory tasks and storage contract
description: Update README, wtp help, wtp schema, CHANGELOG, and CONTRIBUTING after CLI and wire behavior is final. Document definition CRUD, task create/update assignment flags, ordered live-reference semantics, advisory non-enforcement, rename behavior, detach-everywhere deletion, human and JSON claim shapes, batch JSON/CSV preserve/replace/clear rules, canonical export inclusion, shared-store scope, legacy compatibility, and explicit exclusions such as automatic execution or group-end inference. Add a complete example defining tests, code review, version update, and commit items and attaching them in order to the intentionally selected last task in a group. Document .wtp/reusable.json and .wtp/meta/reusable-update.json, including backup, recovery, and ignore guidance. Add documentation contract tests and run diff checks.
